# zutable

zutable is a typed table for R: a data frame that knows each column’s
type, queried through a bracket whose arguments are SQL’s clauses.

- Every column has a logical type from [Apache
  Arrow](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/format/Columnar.html) and a
  nullability, and a query’s result schema and type errors are known
  before any data is read.
- `:=` updates existing columns in place and never changes a table’s
  schema.
- Grouping, sorting, joins and reductions run on a C kernel whose header
  other packages can use through `LinkingTo`.
- It imports no other package;
  [zufast](https://github.com/pedrobtz/zufast), on CRAN, is needed only
  to build it, and `pak` installs it for you.

## Installation

zutable is not on CRAN yet. Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zutable")
```

## Usage

Build a table, then ask the bracket for the volume-weighted price of
each `id` after the first day:

``` r

library(zutable)
trades <- zutable(
  id  = c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L),
  day = as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:4,
  px  = c(10.5, 11, 20, 19.5, 7),
  qty = c(100L, 50L, 10L, 30L, 200L)
)
trades[where = day >= "2026-01-02",
       select = .(vwap = sum(px * qty) / sum(qty)),
       by = id]
#> <zutable> 3 rows x 2 columns
#>   id      vwap
#>   <int32> <float64>
#> 1 1       11.000
#> 2 2       19.625
#> 3 3       7.000
```

zutable also joins, updates in place, freezes and explains tables; Get
started shows each.

## Learn more

- [Get
  started](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/articles/zutable.html):
  one table taken through a query, a type error, a join, an update and
  its plan.
- [Joins without
  surprises](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/articles/joins.html):
  repeated keys, missing keys and key types.
- [Measuring the
  kernel](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/articles/measurements.html):
  the kernel’s timings against collapse, data.table and base R.
- The [reference
  index](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/index.html) lists
  every function.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`conform()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/conform.md)
  [`metadata()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/conform.md)
  : Check a table against a schema
- [`explain()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/explain.md)
  : Explain how a table is computed
- [`grp()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/grp.md) : Group
  rows by keys
- [`grp_join()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/grp_join.md)
  [`grp_match()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/grp_join.md)
  : Join keys as index pairs
- [`grp_reduce()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/grp_reduce.md)
  : Reduce values by group
- [`join()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/join.md) :
  Join two tables
- [`key_order()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/key_order.md)
  [`key_rank()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/key_order.md)
  : Order and rank rows by keys
- [`key_sort()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/key_sort.md)
  : Sort values
- [`na()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/na.md) : A typed
  missing value
- [`rbind(`*`<zutable>`*`)`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/rbind.zutable.md)
  : Bind the rows of zutables
- [`register_extension_type()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/register_extension_type.md)
  : Register an R vector class as an extension type
- [`schema()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/schema.md)
  [`field()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/schema.md)
  [`not_null()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/schema.md)
  : Fields and schemas
- [`vocabulary`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/vocabulary.md)
  [`r`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/vocabulary.md)
  [`cast`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/vocabulary.md)
  [`case`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/vocabulary.md) :
  The expression vocabulary
- [`` `[`( ``*`<zutable>`*`)`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-bracket.md)
  : Query a zutable with SQL's clauses
- [`` `$<-`( ``*`<zutable>`*`)`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-indexing.md)
  [`` `[[<-`( ``*`<zutable>`*`)`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-indexing.md)
  [`` `is.na<-`( ``*`<zutable>`*`)`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-indexing.md)
  [`` `[<-`( ``*`<zutable>`*`)`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-indexing.md)
  : Replace values in a zutable
- [`copy()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-update.md)
  [`freeze()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-update.md)
  [`is_frozen()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable-update.md)
  : Update columns in place
- [`zutable()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable.md)
  [`as_zutable()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable.md)
  [`is_zutable()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable.md)
  : Create a typed table
- [`zutable_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable_info.md)
  : Information about the zutable build

# Articles

### Concepts

- [Joins without
  surprises](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/articles/joins.md):

  What a join does with repeated keys, missing keys, mismatched types
  and clashing names, and how to choose.

- [Measuring the
  kernel](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/articles/measurements.md):

  How the grouping, sorting, join and reduction kernel compares with
  collapse, data.table, kit and base R, and how each number is checked.
